rationale: M37.14-w2 master-review gate fixture. Three defect classes probe-verified on real parses 2026-09: SWIFTD17 — self-container subscript READS and WRITES (`self.storage[k]`, `self.storage[k] = v`) emitted NO uses because the write/call gates treated the subscript base as an assignment LHS / method-call callee; a subscript access is a property READ of the container. Family precedent probe-verified on the same shapes: php emits `uses read->items` AND `uses write->items`, objc emits both too. 62 subscript self-container accesses in the 200-file swift-nio census (49 reads, 13 writes). A pure field write (`self.count = 0`) must STAY gated. SWIFTD18 — multi-binding declarations (`var a = 1, b = 2`, `let g1 = 1, g2 = 2`) carry one sibling `pattern` per binding (probe-verified parse shape) but only the FIRST binding was symbolized; the rest were silently dropped (0 corpus sites in swift-nio but a real completeness hole). SWIFTD19 — dotted qualified names were resolved to the FIRST segment: `extension Outer2.Inner2` minted an extension symbol 'Outer2' that collided with the container type's symbol id and mis-attributed every member; `class Sub: Outer.Inner` emitted implements Sub->Outer and `class Sub2: Foundation.URLSession` emitted extends Sub2->Foundation. user_type holds sibling type_identifiers in source order, so the leaf is the LAST one. 97 dotted extension targets + 6 dotted inheritance bases in the 200-file swift-nio census (mostly nested-type extensions like WebSocketFrame._Storage, NIOBSDSocket.AddressFamily).
